'''Talita Fontoura Alves'''{{efn|According to the custom of [[Portuguese name]]s, "Fontoura" denotes the maternal surname and "Alves" the paternal.}} (b. 1966) is a Brazilian [[botanist]].<ref>{{cite journal|title=Fontoura Alves, Talita (fl. 1984-2009)|url=http://plants.jstor.org/stable/10.5555/al.ap.person.bm000146837|website=plants.jstor.org|publisher=[[JSTOR]]|accessdate=4 November 2017}}</ref> She is a professor of biology and botany at the [[State University of Santa Cruz]] in [[Ilhéus]], Brazil.<ref name=Prof/> She is notable for the discovery and naming of ''[[Quesnelia]] alborosea'', a member of the [[Bromeliaceae]] native to the [[Bahia]] area of Brazil.<ref>{{cite web|title=Bromeliaceae Quesnelia alborosea A.F.Costa & Fontoura|url=http://www.ipni.org/ipni/idPlantNameSearch.do?id=77121365-1|website=ipni.org|publisher=International Plant Names Index|accessdate=17 November 2017}}</ref>

==Biography==
In 1988, Fontoura obtained her [[Licentiate (degree)|licentiate]] from the [[Universidade Santa Úrsula]] in [[Rio de Janeiro]]. She obtained her master's degree in [[ecology]] under the supervision of Dr. [[Fábio Rúbio Scarano]] at the [[University of Campinas]] in 1995, and finally her [[Doctorate]] in 2005, also at the University of Campinas. To finish her education, she conducted her [[postdoctoral studies]] at [[Federal University of Rio de Janeiro]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Talita Fontoura Alves|url=https://www.escavador.com/sobre/449125/talita-fontoura-alves|website=.escavador.com|publisher=Escavador|accessdate=4 November 2017}}</ref>

Since 1996, she has tenured as a professor at the [[State University of Santa Cruz]] in [[Ilhéus]], [[Bahia]],<ref name=Prof>{{cite web|title=MESTRADO EM DESENVOLVIMENTO REGIONAL E MEIO AMBIENTE|url=http://www.uesc.br/cursos/pos_graduacao/mestrado/mdrma/index.php?item=conteudo_corpodocente.php|website=uesc.br|publisher=[[State University of Santa Cruz]]|accessdate=4 November 2017|language=pt|archive-date=7 November 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171107042417/http://www.uesc.br/cursos/pos_graduacao/mestrado/mdrma/index.php?item=conteudo_corpodocente.php|url-status=dead}}</ref> and continues to contribute to the fields of ecology in biodiversity and conservation. Her field of research is the structure and community of [[epiphytes]]. She has begun research on [[Bromeliaceae]] at the [[Rio de Janeiro Botanical Garden]] into the different aspects of that family of plants such as their [[phytogeography]] and [[frugivory]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Talita Fontoura Alves|url=http://buscatextual.cnpq.br/buscatextual/visualizacv.do?id=K4785615U3|website=buscatextual.cnpq.br|publisher=[[National Council for Scientific and Technological Development]]|accessdate=4 November 2017}}</ref>
